post.description: Create a mapping between an external call and a HubSpot CRM object. This endpoint is used to associate call data from third-party systems with HubSpot engagements, enabling seamless integration of call information into the CRM. A successful request returns no content, indicating the mapping was created successfully.

get.description: Retrieve the calling connection statuses for users in your HubSpot account. This endpoint is useful for checking which users are currently connected to the calling service. It supports filtering by user IDs.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: An array of user IDs to filter the connection statuses. Each ID should be an integer.

post.description: Retrieve the connection statuses for a batch of users in a single request. This endpoint is useful for efficiently checking the connection status of multiple users at once, which can help in managing and monitoring user connectivity in your application.

get.description: Retrieve the calling connection status for the authenticated user. This endpoint provides information about whether the user is currently connected to the calling service.

post.description: Process an inbound call through the HubSpot CRM extensions. This endpoint allows integration with third-party calling services to handle call data, including details such as call status, duration, and participant numbers. It is useful for logging call activities and managing call-related engagements within the HubSpot platform.

Record details of an inbound call using the HubSpot API. This endpoint allows you to log information about completed third-party calls, including call status, duration, and participant details. It is useful for integrating third-party calling systems with HubSpot to maintain comprehensive call records.

Mark a call recording as ready for use in the HubSpot CRM. This endpoint is used to update the status of a call recording, indicating that it is available for further processing or review. It requires the engagement ID of the recording to be marked as ready.

get.description: Retrieve the channel connection settings for a specific portal in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides details about the connected channels, including their status and configuration. It is useful for managing and reviewing channel connections within a portal.

parameters.name: portalId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the portal for which to retrieve channel connection settings.

post.description: Create a new transcript for a specified object in your HubSpot account. This endpoint requires a request body containing the objectId, objectType, and transcriptUtterances. The transcript can be associated with either a CALL or MEETING_EVENT object type. Upon successful creation, the response includes the URL of the newly created resource.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

get.description: Retrieve the transcript for a specific object in the CRM. This endpoint allows you to access the transcript details associated with a particular object type and ID, which can be useful for reviewing call or meeting details.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object for which the transcript is being retrieved.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of the object for which the transcript is being retrieved, such as 'CALL' or 'MEETING_EVENT'.

get.description: Retrieve a specific transcript by its unique identifier. This endpoint is useful for accessing the details of a transcript associated with a call or meeting event, including the transcript's creation and update timestamps, source, and utterances.

parameters.name: transcriptId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the transcript to retrieve.

delete.description: Delete a specific transcript from your HubSpot account using the transcript's unique identifier. This operation is useful for managing and maintaining the accuracy and relevance of stored transcripts.

parameters.name: transcriptId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the transcript to delete.

get.description: Retrieve the settings for a specific calling app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access configuration details such as the app's URL, dimensions, and capabilities like inbound calling support. Use this to verify or inspect the current settings applied to your calling app.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app whose settings you want to retrieve.

post.description: Create or update the settings for a specific calling app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to configure various settings such as the app's name, URL, dimensions, and capabilities like inbound calling support. Ensure that the appId is correctly specified to apply the settings to the intended app.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app for which the settings are being configured. It must be an integer.

delete.description: Delete the calling extension settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This operation removes the settings associated with the given appId, effectively disabling any configurations set for the calling extension.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app whose calling extension settings are to be deleted. It is an integer.

patch.description: Update the settings for a specific calling app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify various configuration options for the app identified by the appId path parameter. It is useful for developers who need to adjust app settings dynamically.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app whose settings are to be updated.

get.description: Retrieve the channel connection settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides details about the channel connection configuration, including its readiness status and associated URL. It is useful for developers who need to verify or display the current settings of a channel connection for a given app.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve channel connection settings. It must be an integer.

post.description: Create a new channel connection setting for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows developers to configure settings related to channel connections, including whether the connection is ready and the URL associated with it. This is useful for integrating third-party calling services with HubSpot.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the channel connection settings are being created. It must be an integer.

delete.description: Delete the channel connection settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This operation removes the configuration associated with the app's channel connection, effectively disconnecting it. Use this endpoint when you need to remove an app's integration with the calling extension.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app whose channel connection settings are to be deleted.

patch.description: Update the channel connection settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify the settings related to channel connections, such as the readiness status and URL. Ensure that the appId is correctly specified to update the intended app settings.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the channel connection settings are to be updated. It must be an integer.

get.description: Retrieve the event webhook settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides the current configuration of webhook URLs associated with calling events, allowing developers to verify or audit the settings for their integrations.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve event webhook settings.

put.description: Update the event webhook settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to configure the target URL for receiving event notifications related to calling extensions. Ensure that the provided URL is correctly set up to handle incoming webhook data.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the event webhook settings are being updated.

post.description: Create a new event webhook for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to set up a webhook URL to receive event notifications for the specified app. It is useful for integrating external systems with HubSpot by receiving real-time updates on certain events.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the event webhook is being created. It must be an integer.

delete.description: Delete the event webhook settings for a specified app in your HubSpot account. This operation removes the webhook configuration associated with the provided appId, effectively stopping any event notifications from being sent to the previously configured target URL.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the event webhook settings are to be deleted.

get.description: Retrieve the list of event webhook subscriptions for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows developers to view all the webhook subscriptions associated with a given app, identified by its appId. This can be useful for managing and auditing webhook configurations.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve webhook subscriptions. It must be an integer.

post.description: Create a new event webhook subscription for a specified app in HubSpot. This endpoint allows developers to subscribe to specific events, such as 'TICKET_CREATED', 'CALL_CREATED', or 'CALL_UPDATED', for their app. The subscription will trigger a webhook call to the specified URL whenever the event occurs.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the event webhook subscription is being created.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: The type of event to subscribe to. Valid values are 'TICKET_CREATED', 'CALL_CREATED', and 'CALL_UPDATED'.

delete.description: Delete a specific event webhook subscription for a calling app. This operation is useful for managing and cleaning up event subscriptions that are no longer needed for your application. Ensure that the appId and eventType are correctly specified to avoid unintended deletions.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the calling app for which the subscription is to be deleted.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: The type of event for which the subscription is to be deleted. Valid values are 'TICKET_CREATED', 'CALL_CREATED', and 'CALL_UPDATED'.

get.description: Retrieve the recording settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides the URL to access authenticated recordings, which is essential for managing and accessing call recordings associated with the app.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which to retrieve recording settings.

post.description: Update the recording settings for a specific app in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to configure the URL used to retrieve authenticated recordings. Ensure that the appId provided corresponds to the app whose settings you wish to update.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the recording settings are being updated. It must be an integer.

patch.description: Update the recording settings for a specific app in the HubSpot CRM. This endpoint allows you to modify the URL used to retrieve authenticated recordings for the specified app. It is useful for developers who need to change the recording retrieval settings without altering other configurations.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the recording settings are being updated. It must be an integer.
